quality.review_scope: Independent scientific audit of all 7 supplied main pages and the accepted correction revision passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Supplied seven-page main only; the separately mentioned SI and cited methods/calibrations remain unreviewed.
No measured atomic coordinate file or complete atomistic surface model is supplied.
The generic Family 378 XRD/TEM/DOSY specimen is not assigned an exact temperature/time batch. Dried-state and dispersed-state sizes must remain distinct.
Growth aliquots in Figures 2 and 3 share their respective time-course batches; separate records preserve condition variants, not independent-batch replication.
Centrifuge speed/time, absolute antisolvent endpoint amount, detailed cooling/storage and physical batch IDs are unreported.
Molecular, apparatus and morphology illustration refinements remain presentation pending.
